'''Sluices''' are automated devices that sift valuables from running water in ''Prospecting!''. Great for passive income and progression.

They can be placed in flowing water to collect while you explore or are offline.

'''Sluices''' have [[Stats|four core stats]]: {{Stat|Luck}}, {{Stat|Capacity}}, {{Stat|Efficiency}}, and {{Stat|Toughness}}. Many sluices can be upgraded by talking to the [[Mad Scientist]] in the small workshop near the {{Crystal Caverns}} [[Waypoints|waypoint]].

Use the [[Prospector Kit]] to equip or unequip your sluice.

|-|Sluice Upgrades (Crystal Caverns)=
''How upgrades work''
* Upgradeable sluices have a set amount of '''Upgrade Points''' to allocate across their stats.
* Most stats cost '''1 point per tier''' up to '''10 tiers'''.
* Some perks have special costs (for example, '''Autocollect = 5 points''', while '''Size Boost = 2 points per tier'''). 
* Each tier also requires the listed '''cash''' and '''material'''.

''Special Upgrades''
; {{Stat|Autocollect}}
: Ores go directly into your backpack while you are online (subject to your auto-sell settings and/or Annihilation [[Runes]]). Offline sluice behavior is not affected.
; {{Stat|Empowering}}
: The sluice grants boosts when emptied. The duration of the boost is proportional to the amount of time the sluice spent collecting ores: <pre>Capacity &times; (480 collecting seconds &div; Efficiency) &times; (3  boost seconds &div; 60 collecting seconds)</pre>
; {{Stat|Self-propulsion}}
: The sluice can be placed in non-flowing water.

''Not upgradeable''
* '''Wood Sluice Box''' – ❌
* '''Steel Sluice Box''' – ❌
